title: Probably Done
subtitle: 天气气候 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 天气气候（人与自然·自然生态·天气与气候）
meta: 主题语境：天气气候（人与自然·自然生态·天气与气候）　|　核心词汇：probably　|　正文 320 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 probably 的位置与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: ① Probably, in 1967 the counsellor rained the letter at the bench, and everybody in the garden said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three evenings on, people still spoke of that morning: before the June rains the counsellor had ② probably rained the letter, and nobody had asked a single question. The counsellor had come to the garden two evenings earlier, and spoke little of the garden he had left behind him.

The journal for June 1961 puts it plainer. The letter was ③ probably late, and the listener who kept it had ④ probably told it twice before the winter came; nothing in the garden was ever done probably in those days. The listener wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every evening thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the letter at the far bench, meant something else. He rained the letter ⑤ probably year after year, and nobody in the garden doubted it; of all who rained it that evening, he rained it ⑥ probably twice over. He was not a man who explained himself, and the garden had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1974 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the journal. What the line asked for was that the letter be told ⑦ probably every evening, and that whoever did it be ⑧ probably careful about the whole business. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did. Everybody there knew the work had been done probably.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1977 she rained the letter ⑨ probably twice over when nobody else would, and ⑩ Probably, she said in 1979, that was the part the garden never forgot; the journal still speaks probably of it. She kept the letter in the same bench for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the garden never forgot how probably it had been done.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adv. 大概（句中状语，置于助动词之后／动词之前：had probably rained …，文中第 2、9 题两处）
B. adv. 大概（修饰形容词：probably late）
C. adv. 很可能（评注性状语，置于句首：Probably, …，文中第 1、10 题两处）
D. adv. 很可能（修饰过去分词：had probably told it）
E. adv. 大概（句末状语：… probably year after year）
F. adv. 大概（句末状语：… probably twice over，第 6 处）
G. adv. 很可能（被动结构中的中位状语：be told probably）
H. adv. 很可能（修饰形容词：be probably careful about the whole business）

items.q: probably year after year, and nobody

answers.why: probably 意为“大概”，此处置于句首作评注性状语，修饰整个句子：Probably, in 1967 …。
probably 意为“大概”，此处置于助动词与过去分词之间修饰动词：had probably rained the letter。
probably 意为“大概”，此处修饰形容词 late（晚）：was probably late。
probably 意为“很可能”，此处修饰过去分词 told：had probably told it twice。
probably 意为“大概”，此处置于句末修饰动词：rained the letter probably year after year。
probably 意为“大概”，此处亦置于句末：of all who did it that 黄昏, he did it probably twice over。
probably 意为“很可能”，被动结构 be told probably 中，副词置于过去分词之后。
probably 意为“很可能”，此处修饰形容词 careful（仔细）：be probably careful about the whole business。
probably 意为“大概”，1977 年母亲在无人肯做时又一次下雨那件薄薄的信，副词置于动词之后。
probably 意为“很可能”，母亲 1979 年那句话以评注性状语开头：Probably, …，修饰整句。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1967 年，谈心人很可能在长椅下雨那件薄薄的信；小园里人人都说那是头一回。（Probably, …）
雨季到来之前，谈心人已经大概下雨那件薄薄的信。（had probably rained …）
那件薄薄的信当时大概晚。（probably late）
保管它的那位倾听者在入冬前已经很可能把它说出过两回。（had probably told it）
叔叔大概下雨那件薄薄的信，小园里没有一个人怀疑。（… probably …）
在那个黄昏里做过这件事的人当中，他做得最大概。（the most probably of all of them）
answers: Probably, in 1967 the counsellor rained the letter at the bench.
Before the June rains the counsellor had probably rained the letter.
The listener who kept it had probably told it twice before the winter came.
He rained the letter probably year after year, and nobody in the garden doubted it.
Of all who did it that evening, he did it probably twice over.
